test_title: PYST 63: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: After successive discounts of 26% and 22.5%, an item was sold at a profit of 24%. If the cost price of the item was ₹925, what was the marked price (in ₹) of the item?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (C.P) = ₹925

Successive discounts = 26% and 22.5%

Profit = 24%

**Formula used:**

Marked Price (M.P) × (1 - Discount1/100) × (1 - Discount2/100) = Selling Price (S.P)

S.P = C.P × (1 + Profit/100)
